subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a shared provider catalog-refresh hook for configured `/v1/models` endpoints, starting with OpenRouter, or keep discovery entirely provider-specific through the existing runtime hooks?
rationale: The current code already separates provider behavior from the generic loop, but cache lifetime, credential/tenant scope, failure behavior, and which catalog rows are safe to expose are durable product and API-contract choices.

options.title: Sponsor the shared hook
options.body: Define a narrow provider SDK catalog-refresh contract with bounded caching and make OpenRouter the first implementation.

options.title: Provider-owned only
options.body: Document and implement OpenRouter discovery solely through existing dynamic-model and catalog-augmentation hooks without adding a new shared catalog API.

options.title: Defer live catalogs
options.body: Keep the current forward-compatible resolution and wildcard visibility while relying on static or configured catalogs for listing.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the shared hook
recommendation.body: Define a narrow provider SDK catalog-refresh contract with bounded caching and make OpenRouter the first implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits place the shared model-catalog and plugin-extension ownership closest to this contract decision.
